name: WARNING: Dutch Bros Hot Chai Tea Latte (Spicy Concentrate & Whole Milk)
whyItWorks: Commercial Oregon Chai concentrate containing black pepper extract, clove oils, and ginger oleoresin combined with steamed dairy milk. Pepper heat and dairy cause gastric burning and intestinal hypermotility.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip commercial spicy chai. Choose mild chamomile herbal tea or a steamed oat milk vanilla steamer.
